excerpts:
Agentic AI: Hype or the next evolution of investment management?

Overview

Is agentic AI a genuine transformation for investment management, or the next stage of the AI hype cycle? Generative AI has changed how professionals work with information. Agentic AI represents a potential next step: systems that can plan, reason, and act autonomously to complete increasingly complex investment tasks. Enthusiasm is building, and questions remain. What role should autonomous AI play within investment organizations? Which tasks should stay firmly under human oversight? How should firms balance innovation with governance, accountability, and trust? Andrew Crain, Director, Ethics & Professional Standards at CFA Institute, Stefan Jansen, Founder at Applied AI, and Denis de Montigny, CFA, Honorary Senior Research Fellow at University College London, examine the opportunities, limitations, and implications of agentic AI for investment professionals. Register now. Timings: 11:00 AM ET | 4 :00 PM GMT CFA Institute members can self-report 1 PL credit for attending.

Key discussion points

* What agentic AI is: Understand how agentic AI differs from the AI tools in use today.
* Potential applications: Explore where agentic AI may apply within investment management.

results.title: ONNX | About
excerpts:
About

We believe there is a need for greater interoperability in the AI tools community. Many people are working on great tools, but developers are often locked in to one framework or ecosystem. ONNX is the first step in enabling more of these tools to work together by allowing them to share models.
Our goal is to make it possible for developers to use the right combinations of tools for their project. We want everyone to be able to take AI from research to reality as quickly as possible without artificial friction from toolchains. We hope you'll join us in this mission!
ONNX Logo Icon
Community image

Community

ONNX is a community project. We encourage you to join the effort and contribute feedback, ideas and code.
For more information, check out our contribution guide , or join a Special Interest Group (SIG) or Working Group today.

Partners

ONNX is supported by a community of partners
Technical Design image

Technical Design

ONNX provides a definition of an extensible computation graph model, as well as definitions of built-in operators and standard data types.
Each computation dataflow graph is structured as a list of nodes that form an acyclic graph.

...

Operators are implemented externally to the graph, but the set of built-in operators are portable across frameworks. Every framework supporting ONNX will provide implementations of these operators on the applicable data types.
More details can be found on GitHub .

The early builders on the new Rasa engine.
Discord · How it works · FAQ · Showcase

What this is

Rasa is building the next generation of its engine — a new way to build, orchestrate, and control AI agents. Before it launches publicly, a small, hand-picked group of developers is building on it first: the Rasa Heroes .
Heroes get hands-on access as it rolls out, a direct line to the team building it, and their builds showcased when the engine launches. In return, they build real things, hit the rough edges before anyone else does, and tell us the truth about it.
This repository is the public home of the program. Starter examples, instructions, and community builds all land here.
Where things stand: the program runs ahead of full public access. Hands-on builds roll out to Heroes in waves — every rollout is announced in the Disco

...

and the materials appear here. We'd rather show you exactly where we are than polish a story.

How it works

1. Join. Heroes are added on a rolling basis. Start by joining the Rasa Agent Engineering Community on Discord and introducing yourself in the community — what you build, and what you'd want to build on the new engine.
2. Build. When access opens for your cohort, you get starter examples (in examples/ ), docs, and a Rasa Pro license from us. Bring your own use case — the interesting feedback never comes from the happy path.

Cube Core is the open-source semantic layer. Define metrics, dimensions, joins, and access rules once in code, then expose them through SQL, REST, and GraphQL APIs to anything downstream — BI tools, custom applications, or AI agents. Cube Core is headless: it doesn't ship a UI, so you can build the analytics experience that fits your product.
Cube Core works with all SQL data sources, including cloud data warehouses like Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery; query engines like Presto and Amazon Athena; and application databases like Postgres. It has a built-in relational caching engine to provide sub-second latency and high concurrency for API requests.

Describe Botcamp in a nutshell. ¶

Botcamp is a training program for market makers and algo traders. It provides a structured curriculum and monthly live sessions that teach members how to design and develop strategies from scratch using Hummingbot, as well as monthly bot trading compeitions for them to test their strategies under real-world conditions.

How does new monthly version of Botcamp differ from the past version? ¶

Botcamp started as an intensive 6-week developer bootcamp that culminated in a Demo Day. More than 120 students across 5 cohorts took the course, and many of the open-source sample scripts located in the /scripts folder on Hummingbot were contributed by Botcamp students.

excerpts:
About

AI4Finance Foundation is a U.S.-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit public charity dedicated to advancing the application of artificial intelligence in the financial sector. Our mission is to promote standardized practices and develop open-source resources that benefit both researchers and industry professionals. We are committed to driving innovation and fostering collaboration in the use of AI technologies for financial services.

Open-source Libraries

Currently, our libraries have garnered significant attention, with around 27,000 Github stars and reliance from tens of thousands of projects worldwide. They represent some of the most widely utilized resources in the realm of financial machine learning.

Short-term Goal

In the short term, our goals include implementing substantial improvements to the usability, productivity, and performance of our core libraries. We aim to foster their adoption across the open-source finance ecosystem, provide ongoing maintenance and bug fixes for mature environments, and integrate more key open-source projects into our portfolio, elevating them to our standards of maturity.

Long-term Goal

For the long term, our ambitions extend to offering enhanced standardization tools for professionals engaged in applied financial tasks. This includes developing resources akin to a standardized API for financial environments, as well as broadening our suite of open-source tools beyond the foundational layers.

README.md

Hi, this is eosphoros-ai 👋

Discord Slack stars
We are a team of technology enthusiasts from AntGroup、JD、internet companies and NLP graduate students who are passionate about open source projects. Our aim is to building Open AI-Native Data Infrastructure
As we move towards an era of large models, we have personally witnessed the power of open source technology. We strongly believe that many technologies, including the abilities of large models, LLMOps-related frameworks, Text2SQL accuracy, etc., will become the infrastructure of the new era. Through our open source organization, we strive to contribute to the development of this new era.
We have the following open-source projects:
* DB-GPT , AI Native Data App Development framework with AWEL(Agentic Workflow Expression Language) and Agents
* DB-GPT-Hub A repository that contains models, datasets, and fine-tuning techniques for DB-GPT, with the purpose of enhancing model performance in Text-to-SQL
* Awesome-Text2SQL Curated tutorials and resources for Large Language Models, Text2SQL, Text2DSL、Text2API、Text2Vis and more.

Unityについて

Unityとはユニティ・テクノロジーズ株式会社が提供している、ゲーム開発エンジンです。ゲームに限らず、Unityのバーチャル技術は産業界や教育研究分野で応用されています。

Unityのインストール方法

学生の場合

学生の場合は，個人PCにインストールします。
* まずはUnity Personal版でインストールください。
* 以下のリンクから申し込みできます。
* https://store.unity.com/ja/products/unity-personal
* GitHubと連携した「Unity Student Plan」を利用できます（推奨）。
* https://store.unity.com/ja/academic/unity-student
※Unity Student Planとは、Unity Pro 相当のソフトウェアを5名のチームメンバーで共有利用ができるものです。Unity Student Planにある複数のツールを使うことにより、無償提供される25GBのクラウド上でプロジェクトの共有ができ、簡単でかつ効率的な開発が可能となります。
Unity Student Plan にアクセスする方法は、以下の通りです。学生が各自で手続きをします。
1. https://store.unity.com/ja/academic/unity-student Unity Student Plan にサインナップします。
2. Unity ID とGitHub アカウントを作成するか、ログインするように求められます。

Companies invest in campus experts and student ambassadors to grow authentic developer communities at universities—clubs, workshops, and peer mentoring—not just coupon codes.

The official AG-UI protocol repository, positioned as the agent-user interaction layer for bringing agents into frontend applications. Tracel Inc.

About Tracel

We're fixing an important problem

The current AI ecosystem, developed through collaborative research efforts, has led to an incredible AI revolution. However, it still faces significant challenges.
Porting models across different platforms requires enormous effort, with training and inference often requiring separate implementations. The ecosystem remains fragmented across hardware vendors, which can slow innovation and hinder deployment.
Hardware-specific optimizations, required for efficient model execution, create additional complexity. This limits flexibility and requires teams to maintain multiple versions of the same model to achieve optimal performance across different accelerators.

We're on a mission

We're on a mission to make artificial intelligence more efficient, flexible, and portable. Our goal is to enable groundbreaking research while meeting the strictest requirements for production deployments.

What is an AIDA Ambassador?

AIDA Ambassadors are people who are enthusiastic about the potential of artificial intelligence and interested in helping Boston University advance the responsible and effective use of AI across education, research, administration, and community engagement.
You do not need to be an AI expert to participate. We welcome faculty, staff, and students from all backgrounds who are curious about AI, eager to learn, and interested in helping connect their schools to AI-related opportunities, resources, and conversations.

AIDA Ambassadors will serve as local champions and connectors for AI across the BU community. They will be listed on the AIDA website and help connect faculty, staff, and students to AIDA resources and programming.  We expect ambassadors to become familiar with AIDA’s mission, activities, and “critical embrace” approach to AI. They will share ideas, approaches, concerns, and feedback from their schools with AIDA leadership, while also helping to disseminate information about AI resources and opportunities back to their units. Open-source, terminal-based AI coding agent for large, multi-step tasks, handling up to 2M tokens of context in a review sandbox before applying changes.
Plandex is built specifically for coding tasks too large or too multi-step for most AI assistants to handle well: it supports context windows up to 2 million tokens and can index more than 20 million tokens total, using tree-sitter maps to navigate large codebases without losing track of how files relate to each other.
Its diff review sandbox keeps AI-generated changes isolated until a developer approves them, offering a choice between full autonomy, where Plandex plans, generates, executes, and debugs code on its own, or a step-by-step workflow with manual review at each stage. It supports a hybrid multi-model approach, mixing Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and open-source models to balance speed, cost, and quality rather than committing to one provider.
Plandex Cloud wound down in October 2025, so it's now self-hosted only, which narrows its audience to developers and teams comfortable running their own infrastructure, a real but smaller group than the one a hosted option would reach.

Empower your Data Journey with OpenMetadata
Commit Activity Release

What is OpenMetadata?

OpenMetadata is a unified metadata platform for data discovery, data observability, and data governance powered by a central metadata repository, in-depth column level lineage, and seamless team collaboration. It is one of the fastest-growing open-source projects with a vibrant community and adoption by a diverse set of companies in a variety of industry verticals. Based on Open Metadata Standards and APIs, supporting connectors to a wide range of data services, OpenMetadata enables end-to-end metadata management, giving you the freedom to unlock the value of your data assets.
Contents:
* Features
* Try our Sandbox
* Install & Run
* Roadmap
* Documentation and Support
* Contributors
OpenMetadata Consists of Four Main Components:
* Metadata Schemas : These are the core definitions and vocabulary for metadata based on common abstractions and types. They also allow for custom extensions and properties to suit different use cases and domains.
* Metadata Store : This is the central repository for storing and managing the metadata graph, which connects data assets, users, and tool-generated metadata in a unified way.
* Metadata APIs : These are the interfaces for producing and consuming metadata, built on top of the metadata schemas.

...

* Ingestion Framework : This is a pluggable framework for ingesting metadata from various sources and tools to the metadata store.

About the name and logo of Kaldi

According to legend, Kaldi was the Ethiopian goatherder who discovered the coffee plant. The name was chosen by sponsors of this project because they drank a lot of coffee that time (in 2009 according to Ondrej Glembek ). Then the logo symbolizes those guys working on a speech project (the microphone in the logo) while drinking coffee (the coffee bean in the logo).

Palmier Io

Palmier Io is an AI-native video editor built for creators who want to generate and edit AI media in one continuous workflow. Instead of juggling separate AI generation websites and a traditional non-linear editor, Palmier Io places multi-model AI generation directly on the editing timeline. 开场判断

Palmier Pro 真正做对的一件事，是把视频编辑器的内部状态——轨道、剪辑、标记、生成任务——包装成了 50 个语义清晰的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，模型上下文协议）工具，让 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 这类编程 Agent 无需任何视频编辑器经验，就能像改代码一样改时间线。UI 只是这套工具面的一个消费者。
它的故事还有另一条线：这个项目 2026 年 4 月以 GPLv3 开源（ GitHub 仓库 ），靠 “built for AI” 的定位在半年内拿下 14,480 GitHub stars 和官网宣称的 100K+ 下载；2026 年 8 月 19 日的 v0.7.6 成了最后一个开源版本，此后转向专有发行，仓库也不再接受代码贡献。理解这条线，比理解任何一个功能都重要——它决定了你今天拿到手的是什么。

Why Horovod? ¶

The primary motivation for this project is to make it easy to take a single-GPU training script and successfully scale it to train across many GPUs in parallel. This has two aspects:
1. How much modification does one have to make to a program to make it distributed, and how easy is it to run it?
2. How much faster would it run in distributed mode?

...

Once a training script has been written for scale with Horovod, it can run on a single-GPU, multiple-GPUs, or even multiple hosts without any further code changes.

...

Horovod core principles are based on MPI concepts such as size, rank, local rank, allreduce, allgather, broadcast, and alltoall. See this page for more details.

Supported frameworks ¶

...

To use Horovod, make the following additions to your program:
1. Run hvd.init() to initialize Horovod.
2. Pin each GPU to a single process to avoid resource contention.

Flair is:
* A powerful NLP library. Flair allows you to apply our state-of-the-art natural language processing (NLP) models to your text, such as named entity recognition (NER), part-of-speech tagging (PoS), special support for biomedical data, sense disambiguation and classification, with support for a rapidly growing number of languages.
* A text embedding library. Flair has simple interfaces that allow you to use and combine different word and document embeddings, including the proposed Flair embeddings, BERT embeddings and ELMo embeddings.

To help implement this program successfully, there are some general requirements that apply to all Nmap projects sponsored as part of the Google Summer of Code. If you have questions or concerns about these, please let us know before accepting a stipend:
* You need to have sufficient time available. Since the program is so short and most of the tasks are quite challenging, you need to have 25–40 hours available just about every week.

...

The point of the program is to excite students about open source programming, not to burn them out :).
* You need to be self-motivated.

...

Obviously code must be secure, clean, and maintainable.
* Most development communication should take place on the Nmap Dev mailing list . This allows the whole Nmap development community to contribute ideas, try out your code and send feedback, etc. SoC-specific administrative matters or personal issues are more apropriately sent the Nmap SoC list or to Fyodor directly.
* Status reports must be sent to the dev(a)nmap.org list every Monday by 11:59PM Pacific Time . The first one is due on May 15, and the 17th (final) one, which should mark the successful completion of your project, is due on September 4. Since the program actually finishes on August 29, feel free to send your final status report early. While you may know exactly what you are working on, these reports help us track and plan for what everyone is up to. It can also lead to students providing useful suggestions for each other.

 SeleniumBase Installation

If installing seleniumbase directly from PyPI , (the Python Package Index), use:

pip install seleniumbase

To upgrade an existing seleniumbase install from PyPI:

pip install -U seleniumbase

If installing seleniumbase from a Git clone, use:

git clone https://github.com/seleniumbase/SeleniumBase.git
 cd SeleniumBase/
pip install .

For a development mode install in editable mode, use:

git clone https://github.com/seleniumbase/SeleniumBase.git
 cd SeleniumBase/
pip install -e .

To upgrade an existing seleniumbase install from GitHub:

git pull # To pull the latest version

Companies invest in campus experts and student ambassadors to grow authentic developer communities at universities—clubs, workshops, and peer mentoring—not just coupon codes.

Open research for LLMs and multimodal foundation models
OpenMOSS is a research group led by Prof. Xipeng Qiu and hosted at the Shanghai Innovation Institute, with close collaboration from Fudan University and MOSI.AI. The group publishes open work across the full foundation-model stack, including model architecture, training, evaluation, interpretability, and real-world applications. Its public GitHub organization includes more than fifty repositories spanning foundation LLMs, vision-language systems, video-audio generation, speech models, audio understanding, embodied AI, and interpretability tooling. Flagship projects include MOSS, MOSS-VL, MOVA, MOSS-TTS-Nano, MOSS-Audio, and Llamascopium. For builders, OpenMOSS is useful because its releases tend to include code, model artifacts, and reproducible research materials rather than announcement-only demos. The group is especially relevant to teams tracking open speech, audio, and multimodal model families from Chinese AI research labs.

The Student Ambassador Program provides STCC students interested in developing leadership and communication skills with the opportunity to serve as role models, advocates, and peer advisors to fellow students. Genspark Japan Geniusプログラムが正式に始動しました
こんにちは、Genspark日本公式です。
Genspark日本コミュニティの公式アンバサダープログラム「Genspark Genius Japan」が、正式に始動しました。
2026年8月19日（水）、そのキックオフイベント「SPARK JAPAN 2026」を、オフラインとライブ配信のハイブリッド形式で開催しました。応募者は1,500人以上。会場は満席となり、オンラインを合わせて多くの方にご参加いただき、大変盛り上がりました。

Genspark Geniusは、世界7地域・40カ国以上から217名の応募者の中から選ばれた公式アンバサダーによるグローバルプログラムです。
日本からは23名のGeniusが第1期メンバーとして活動をスタートしました。北海道から九州まで、多様なバックグラウンドのメンバーが、それぞれの地域と専門領域でAI活用の輪を広げていきます。

개발자이거나 AI 전문가일 필요는 없습니다. 가장 중요한 것은 Genspark에 대한 열정, 주도성, 그리고 사람들을 모을 수 있는 능력입니다. 저희가 중요하게 보는 것은 커뮤니티 구축 역량이며, 기술적인 지식은 활동하면서 자연스럽게 쌓을 수 있습니다. 어떤 종류의 이벤트를 진행할 수 있나요?

미팅과 지속적인 멘토링을 통한 Genspark 팀과의 직접 소통 채널을 제공합니다. 내 도시나 분야가 목록에 없어도 지원할 수 있나요?
물론입니다. 가장 영향력 있는 커뮤니티 중 일부는 소규모 도시에서 시작되었거나, 특정 주제나 산업을 중심으로 완전히 온라인에서 구축되었습니다. 새로운 지역과 분야로 확장하고자 하는 리더를 적극 환영합니다 — 위치는 제한이 되지 않습니다. 내 언어로도 활동할 수 있나요?
네. 이 프로그램은 글로벌 프로그램이며, 커뮤니티에 가장 적합한 언어로 이벤트를 운영하시면 됩니다. 지원서 작성과 지역 간 미팅은 영어로 진행되지만, 비공식적인 분위기입니다. 지원 절차는 어떻게 되나요?

Our mission is to democratize privacy technology - putting open, transparent tools for protecting sensitive data within everyone's reach, and strengthening the privacy and security of individuals and organizations alike.
The Data Privacy Stack is a community-led home for open, transparent tools that help engineers handle private data responsibly - starting with Presidio for PII detection and anonymization and Presidio Research for evaluating detection models, with room to grow.

Guiding principles

Open

Permissively licensed, community-driven, and developed in the open.

Transparent

Clear about what's detected, how, and why - no black boxes.

Composable

Independent building blocks you can adopt one piece at a time.

Welcome to the Data Privacy Stack

The Data Privacy Stack is a community-led home for open, transparent tools for private data handling - from the authors of Presidio .

Why now

Section titled “Why now”
Handling private data well shouldn’t depend on a single vendor or a black box. Presidio has grown into a widely adopted framework for detecting and anonymizing PII, and the Data Privacy Stack gives it - and future privacy tools - a neutral, community-governed home where they can be maintained in the open and evolve together.

What to expect

Section titled “What to expect”
* Presidio, continued. Active development under community governance .
* More tools over time. The stack is designed to grow into a set of composable privacy building blocks.
* Open and transparent by default. Direction is set in public, and the tools are clear about what they do and how.

L’ULiège, membre de l’alliance européenne UNIC, recherche des étudiants volontaires pour devenir ambassadeurs UNIC. Votre mission ? Soutenir et promouvoir les opportunités offertes par cette alliance qui rassemble 10 universités dans des villes européennes. Ensemble, nous imaginons l’université de demain à travers ces concepts clés : l’innovation et l’inclusion.
En 2026-2027, l’alliance souhaite continuer à développer son réseau d’étudiants ambassadeurs. Envie d’en faire partie ?
Postulez avant le 1er octobre !
Cet appel est ouvert aux étudiantes et étudiants de toutes les facultés. Une priorité sera toutefois donnée aux étudiants ayant déjà participé à un événement UNIC ou ayant réalisé un séjour Erasmus chez un des partenaires UNIC. Un certain équilibre entre les facultés sera respecté, dans la mesure du possible.

Tâches et rôle des ambassadeurs

* Lien avec les conseils de faculté ;
* Participation à la diffusion des informations du réseau UNIC ainsi que des offres à destination des étudiants au sein des facultés ;
* Participation à des évènements locaux (physiquement) et internationaux (en ligne) ;
* Échanges réguliers avec les représentants de l’ULiège au Student Board UNIC ;

Founded in 2023 by Andrei Taranchenko and Igor Chtivelband, Tambo AI provides a development framework for building AI assistants and agents directly within React applications. Taranchenko, with a background as a senior software engineer at companies like Coinbase and a history of founding startups such as Escrow Inc., and Chtivelband, a former engineering manager at Meta and co-founder of other ventures, launched the platform to simplify the integration of conversational AI.
The core product, Hydra, is an open-source library that enables developers to create and customize AI-powered user interfaces with minimal code. It is designed to be a 'UI-first' framework, allowing for the construction of complex, streaming, and interactive chat interfaces. The platform targets developers and businesses looking to embed AI capabilities, such as automated customer support or in-app guidance, into their web applications without extensive backend work. The business model is centered around this open-source tool, with potential monetization through enterprise-grade features, support, or hosted services.

results.title: About | SkyPilot
excerpts:
Accelerating the world's most ambitious AI teams

Our Story

Building the future of AI compute

The SkyPilot team in a server room
SkyPilot started as an open-source project at UC Berkeley's Sky Computing Lab, where our founders ran into a problem: cloud providers donated compute to the lab, but most researchers had a hard time migrating to new providers. Valuable compute went unused.
So we built SkyPilot. Instead of forcing developers to pick one cloud, what if we unified all of them into a single pool — a “sky” of compute?
Today, AI compute has become even more fragmented. Every AI team has to find compute anywhere they can. Many clusters, across neoclouds and hyperscalers. Reservations, mixed with bursty resources. Kubernetes. Slurm. VMs. Many accelerator generations. The problem we set out to solve became an industry-wide challenge.
SkyPilot turns fragmented compute into one AI supercomputer. With one platform to manage all AI compute and frontier workloads, AI teams can make the best use of their infrastructure — turning compute into intelligence, faster.

Using contributions from the Flexible Action Fund, AAAS established the Catalyzing Advocacy in Science and Engineering (CASE) workshop to help students like these learn how to channel their passion for science and engineering into effective advocacy.
Now in its third year, the annual three-and-a-half-day CASE workshop—created by a coalition of scientific and engineering societies, universities, and academic organizations— educates students about the structure and organization of Congress and the basics of the federal budget process.
Each spring, the workshop provides an opportunity for a group of upper-class undergraduate and graduate students to learn, to get involved, to advocate for science, and to share their stories with their member of congress. In short, they learn how to make an impact.
Students learn tools for more effective science communication and civic engagement that empower them to become a voice for research and for science throughout their careers.  And, as noted by several of the former CASE participants, they gain a sense of optimism that they can contribute and they can make a difference.

FalkorDB Customer Journey

A curated learning path and engagement framework that guides FalkorDB users from their first database to production-ready graph applications.
This README evolves as the project grows. New resources and messages will be reflected here as they are added.

Purpose

This project provides FalkorDB users with a clear, structured learning path that accompanies them along their journey — from initial sign-up and first query, through best practices and advanced features, all the way to production-scale graph applications.
It contains two pillars:
1. Resources — Educational guides, cheat sheets, and best practices that help users learn FalkorDB at their own pace.

results.title: community | openFrameworks
excerpts:
openFrameworks is a diverse community of hackers, artists, designers, students and teachers from all over the world.

Whether you are just starting out and want to learn from other users, or are looking to contribute to the project, there are tons of resources and opportunities for being part of the community.

Community

The core of the openFrameworks community is centered around two areas:

Forums

The openFrameworks forums are the online home for the community. This should be the first place to visit if you have a question about openFrameworks, want to meet other users, or are looking to share your knowledge and help others learn about the framework.

Github

The openFramework's Github repository is the primary place for discussing and coordinating development and contributions to the project's code, documentation and website. It is the place to visit if you think you have run into a bug, have some ideas / requests for features or want to contribute directly to the project.

Contribute

The openFrameworks community is always welcoming new developers, designers, writers, event organizers, and general enthusiasts to help build a better experience. Check out the following resources on how to get involved.
* Contribute to Development
* Contribute to Documentation
* Participate on the forums

Code of conduct

One of the goals of openFrameworks is to be inclusive to the largest number of contributors, with the most varied and diverse backgrounds possible.

DojoCon Japan 2026 Theme

わかちあう、わかりあう
CoderDojoには、地域も立場も違うさまざまな人たちが集まっています。 子どもたちの「やってみたい」を応援する人。 道場を続ける人。新しく始めようとする人。 それぞれの経験や思いを持ち寄り、話し、聞き、わかちあうことで、 少しずつお互いをわかりあっていきます。
ロゴは盛岡城跡の石垣とステンドグラスをイメージしました。 さまざまな色や形を持つ個々がその形を保ったまま1つの形を成す姿は、 多様な価値観を持つ人たちが集まり1つの場をつくるCoderDojoの姿にも重なります。
DojoCon Japan 2026は、全国のCoderDojoに関わる人たちが集い、 互いの思いと経験をわかちあう、わかりあう1日です。

About CoderDojo

コーダー道場とは？ CoderDojo
CoderDojoは子ども達にプログラミングを学ぶ場を提供する、ボランティア主導の国際的な非営利活動です。（*1） CoderDojoは2011年にアイルランドから始まり、日本国内では全国に200以上の道場で毎年1,200回以上（*2）開催されています。
CoderDojoに参加する子ども達にとっては、エンジニアやデザイナー、各地域の保護者や学生、研究者や経営者など（メンター）と出会える場にもなっています。
* *1 地図で見る: https://map.coderdojo.jp/world
* *2 統計を見る: https://coderdojo.jp/stats

DojoCon Japanとは？

DojoCon Japanは、全国のCoderDojoコミュニティメンバーが集まる年に1度のカンファレンスイベントです。 2016年から開催されており、その年ごとに異なる地域の実行委員会が中心となって運営されています。 各地のCoderDojoで活動するチャンピオン、メンター、保護者などが集まり、それぞれの取り組みや経験を共有しながら交流を深めます。
セッションやワークショップ、パネルディスカッションなどを通じて運営の工夫や課題、子どもたちとの関わり方、新しい技術やアイデアについて学び合う場となっています。また、普段は地域ごとに活動している仲間たちが直接顔を合わせ、新たなつながりを生み出す貴重な機会でもあります。

The 2024 Forbes 30 Under 30 awards have spotlighted the duo of Matt Shumer and Jason Kuperberg ’18, founders of OthersideAI, who got their start at the University’s Blackstone LaunchPad . The two entrepreneurs were selected in the highly competitive consumer technology category.
Their journey began during the pandemic when, as participants in the LaunchPad’s 2020 SummerStart Accelerator program, Shumer, who was a student in the Whitman School of Management, and Kuperberg, who was a student in the College of Arts and Sciences, conceptualized and brought to life OthersideAI. Shumer, CEO of the company, attributes their initial success to the invaluable support of the Blackstone LaunchPad network. Both are still volunteer entrepreneurs in residence at the LaunchPad and regularly mentor student startups. As students, they were both LaunchPad Global Innovation Fellows and Rubin Family Mentors and winners of various campus student startup competitions.
OthersideAI stands out as one of the first commercial products entirely built on GPT-3, OpenAI’s powerful and versatile AI model. excerpts:
# Welcome!

## The Stanford NLP Group

Welcome to the Natural Language Processing Group at Stanford University! We are a passionate, inclusive group of students, faculty, postdocs, and research engineers, who work together on algorithms that allow computers to process, generate, and understand human languages. Our interests are very broad, including basic scientific research on computational linguistics and machine learning, everything large language models, practical applications of human language technology, and interdisciplinary work in computational social science, human-centered NLP, and cognitive science. We also develop a wide variety of NLP educational materials and many tools for the community, including [Stanza](https://stanfordnlp.github.io/stanza/) , software which processes text in over 75 human languages, and [DSPy](https://dspy.ai/) , a Python framework for programming rather than prompting LLMs.

Bindu

Humanity has generated an extraordinary amount of data. Scattered across databases, APIs, documents, governments, hospitals, research labs, farms, factories,

...

We'd build things no one has built yet.
But here's the problem: the data sits behind different paywalls, different auth systems, different countries, different languages. That's not a bug. That's how the world works. People and institutions have every right to control access to what they've created.
So we need agents. Lots of them.

...

But if these agents could find each other, verify who they are, negotiate terms, and pay each other for work without a human brokering every handshake that changes everything.
That's what Bindu is.
Thats we are dreaminig.
We're building the layer that lets agents communicate with full trust, negotiate, and trade with each other. Identity. Communication. Payments. Open protocols: A2A, AP2, X402.
Bindu is open source. It will always be open source.
The collaboration of agents can change humanity. We are building this.

How student and campus tech ambassador programs work, who they are for, and how to find vetted listings.

Companies invest in campus experts and student ambassadors to grow authentic developer communities at universities—clubs, workshops, and peer mentoring—not just coupon codes.

The eLife Community Ambassadors programme empowers early-career researchers to drive positive change in research culture around the world.
Launched by our Early-Career Advisory Group, the eLife Community Ambassadors programme assembles global cohorts of early-career researchers dedicated to transforming research culture worldwide.
Since 2017, the programme has given over 530 early-career researchers the opportunity to build supportive global networks and share solutions to challenges faced by their different communities. Recruitment & Application Timeline

Our recruitment cycle for the 2026-2027 academic year is over. Please check back in March 2027 for live job postings and application links.

Position Overview

Student Leadership Ambassadors (SLAs) represent the student voice within the Office of Student Involvement (SI). By collaborating with professional staff, SLAs play a vital role in shaping the Spartan experience across four key areas:
1. Recognized Student Organizations (RSOs): Supporting our hundreds of student clubs.
2. Fraternity & Sorority Life (FSL): Engaging with the Greek community.
3. Campus Programming: Planning high-impact events like Weeks of Welcome.
4. Leadership Development: Helping peers grow their professional skills.
Our Mission
As part of the SLA, you help us foster a welcoming campus environment. We empower students through leadership, community building, and a sense of belonging that lasts far beyond graduation.

Eligibility Requirements

To apply for an SLA position, students must meet the following criteria:
* Academic Status : Current SJSU undergraduate enrolled in at least 12 units per semester.
* Academic Standing : Maintain “Good Standing” (Minimum 2.0 cumulative and semester GPA).

results.title: Boundary: BAML for AI Application Development | AI Engineer
excerpts:
Boundary

Boundary builds BAML , a programming language for developers building AI applications and agents. Developers declare model calls as typed functions, specifying inputs and expected outputs, with tools for streaming, testing, tracing, and coordinating concurrent work. BAML can run independently or within existing applications: generated typed language bindings let developers call BAML functions from eight languages, including Python, TypeScript, Go, and Swift, without rewriting their codebase.
Founded in 2023 , Boundary is led by co-founders Vaibhav Gupta , CEO, and Aaron Villalpando, CTO. Gupta previously worked on Google ’s Pixel 4 and Microsoft ’s HoloLens; Villalpando built monitoring and streaming systems at Amazon . BAML’s technical approach includes schema-aligned parsing , which repairs malformed model output against declared types. Its language bridges combine a shared native interface with generated typed interfaces, connecting BAML functions to code in other languages.
BAML is free, Apache-2 licensed, and works offline. Boundary’s commercial offering is Boundary Web Services , with observability offered through early access. In its recap of 2024, the company reported growth from 10 to more than 1,000 active developers .

results.title: Welcome to ParadeDB
excerpts:
# Welcome to ParadeDB

> Just use Postgres

When Postgres queries get too slow, developers usually reach for systems like Elasticsearch. ParadeDB makes text and vector search, filters, facets, and joins fast in Postgres, so you can keep scaling with it.

ParadeDB accelerates these queries with a custom index, delivered through the `pg_search` Postgres extension. It runs inside standard Postgres, with no fork or sidecar process.

ParadeDB architecture.

...

One ParadeDB Index combines an inverted index for text, a clustered index for vectors, and columnar storage for filters and aggregates.

## Who is ParadeDB for?

You're likely a good fit for ParadeDB if:

* **You're outgrowing Postgres full-text search or pgvector.** Your queries are getting slower, index builds are taking too long, or you're spending too much time working around feature limits and tuning performance.
* **You're building an application that needs both transactions and search.** You want user-facing search, RAG, or live dashboards without managing multiple databases and the pipelines that keep them in sync.

...

## Who Uses ParadeDB?

ParadeDB powers core search and analytics workloads at organizations ranging from Fortune 500 companies to fast-growing startups.
